findings: UPN confirms approval of the PP coalition on 13 October for the 29 November general election.
The official coalition name is Unión del Pueblo Navarro en coalición con el Partido Popular. UPN heads the Congress list in Navarra.
Combine the already profiled PP and UPN components only in Navarra, after calibration and local overrides and before seat allocation. No new polling estimates are introduced.
National displays count the joint ballot with PP; the actual Navarra ballot remains UPN–PP. Seats are not divided between its organizations.
The party announcement confirms the agreement; it is not a final proclaimed candidate roster.
method: A new ballot version preserves prior saved scenario compositions.
